October 8, 2026


# WhatsApp Business App coexistence


WhatsApp now supports coexistence: connect your WhatsApp Business App number to Bird and keep using the app on your phone. You can also choose to import contacts and recent chat history during setup.


[Connect your WhatsApp Business App](https://bird.com/docs/guides/whatsapp/numbers/connect-business-app) .
